rules: Reject bool/float as exact amounts
Store source timestamp separately; do not substitute it for available_at
No invented sequence numbers for feeds without one
Corrections link to prior evidence; append instead of silently overwriting
One recoverable state writer per partition
Cursor is not reconstructed state
Same Solana slot alone does not establish cross-account atomicity
Cross-domain vectors describe asynchronous knowledge, never one atomic world state
UNKNOWN is not zero
Separate mint/burn, bridge lock/mint, DEX fills and CEX transfers
Wallet labels are uncertain annotations, not proof of beneficial ownership
Do not add aggregator routed volume to the underlying DEX volume
Canonical chain+contract+token-program identity, never uppercase ticker
Distinguish exact payoff identity, empirical relation and untested idea
A right with a queue cannot be silently converted into cash
Each next leg consumes the exact previous integer output
Requested, consumed and residual orderbook amounts remain separate
No linear rescaling of one quote
Retain amount-local failures without hiding valid samples
R/R may coexist; W/R and W/W conflict for the same physical resource
Namespace collisions fail closed
Unknown required capacity or account set rejects admission
Resource completeness derives from qualified instruction/account behavior; EVM accessList alone is not exhaustive
Existing authority owns atomically bound reservation/fence decisions
Worker output cannot authorize its own admission
Retries use the same logical identity
Unknown future external outcome remains HELD under canonical lifecycle
No newest snapshot in historical joins
Do not conflate prediction error with trading profit
Insufficient observations remains UNKNOWN
No automatic promotion from p-value or correlation
